column1: # Residue facts: what a phase may leave under the output dir when it is killed before its record, and what a retry does.
# Input of tools/chain-phases-gen.cx (columns 8..10 of build/chain-phases.tsv); candidate-chain reads only the generated table.
# policy: scrub = remove the listed paths when RECORD does not exist; refuse = stop when any listed path exists without RECORD.
# record and paths are relative to the output dir; paths are comma separated, one * allowed in the last component only.
